incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High GPU memory retention detected on cluster inference-prod-4. Metric: per-gpu reserved mem rising >95% over 10m. Possible long-request buildup. Paging oncall alex_oncall. (runbook: /playbooks/gpu-memory)
alex_oncall: on it. seeing container restarts in the last 3m on pool=gpu-pool-a. paging sre for triage. @rita_sre
rita_sre: joining. can you paste the recent node/container logs? quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference-prod -l pool=gpu-pool-a`?
jordan_runtime: I see repeated prefill spikes in traces - lots of long-context requests (~200k tokens) to model gpt-med-quant. KV cache growth is huge. sending snapshot.
alex_oncall: logs: ```
[2026-03-17T05:10:12Z] container=inf-worker-7 restartCount=3
[2026-03-17T05:10:13Z] runtime ERROR: CudaError: out of memory while allocating 2.0 GiB
[2026-03-17T05:10:13Z] prefill: seq_len=180000 tokens, kv_bytes=3.4GiB
``` 
rita_sre: that matches OOM on prefill. nodes are flapping (OOM -> kube restart). adding `oom-signal` tag. risk: noisy long requests causing slow mem ramp and restarts.
maya_cust-success: have we seen user-facing errors? CS report: 4% 5xx rate increased for customers on region-us-east, some streaming sessions dropped. I'll prepare a customer note draft.
ryan_infra: infra alert: node-42 shows kernel logs with `GPU reset` then kubelet restarts. NV drivers show transient `ECC` logs but not widespread. looks like sustained mem pressure triggers device reset.
alex_oncall: mitigation plan (short): 1) enable adaptive-prefill-throttle for pool gpu-pool-a (reduce concurrency for long-context) 2) force-fallback to gpt-small-quant for active sessions >120s 3) cordon noisy node-42 4) kick rolling restart of affected server group. any objections?
rita_sre: +1 to throttle. we should also trim KV cache max per-session to 512MB as temporary hotfix (runtime config flag `--kv-max-per-session`). jordan_runtime can you stage that config and a canary rollout?
jordan_runtime: prepping canary: will patch runtime image with `--kv-max-per-session=536870912` and `--prefill-threshold=100000` to reject huge prefill. deploying to one replica now.
alex_oncall: runbook step: if CUDA reset continues after patch, scale down long-context routes and enable `coldmodel-fallback` for heavy requests.
rita_sre: while canary deploys, I'm going to manually evict pods with highest restart counts and mark them unschedulable to avoid churn. `kubectl drain node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (doing in 30s)
jordan_runtime: canary patch applied to inf-worker-canary-3. logs show prefill throttles kicking in: `prefill_rejected: seq_len 182000 reason=throttle`.
alex_oncall: nice. what's the customer impact delta? maya?
maya_cust-success: CS: initial blip caused some streaming disconnects; after throttle started ~5 minutes ago, errors dropped from 4% -> 1.2%. customers A and C reported retries ok. drafting status: "We mitigated a memory saturation issue; some streaming sessions experienced interruptions, customers were notified." Want approval to send.
ryan_infra: infra side: cordoned node-42 and migrated pods. kernel GPU reset frequency fell. also increased instance-level swap target to allow GPU spill-on-oom for the cluster (temporary). monitoring memory headroom.
rita_sre: proposing additional follow-ups: - add limits in API layer to cap requested sequence length to 120k tokens by default; - add model-level guardrails to reject single prefill >200k tokens; - perf: investigate KV cache compaction.
alex_oncall: agree. immediate action done. I'm going to update incident timeline and handoff to night oncall at `1829520000`. rita, jordan, ryan please add follow-up tickets.
jordan_runtime: created ticket INF-4823 "runtime: kv cache cap + prefill threshold" with reproducer and canary logs.
rita_sre: created ticket SRE-2141 "investigate GPU reset ECC logs and driver telemetry". tagging eng-runtime and infra.
maya_cust-success: customer note approved. posting now to affected customers and status page.
alex_oncall: status page update: "We experienced GPU memory saturation impacting streaming on inference-prod-us-east. Mitigation: throttling long-context prefill and rolling restarts. Customer impact: brief streaming interruptions for small percentage of sessions. Full remediation in progress." :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=SEV3, start=1829500123, mitigated=1829500500, assignees=[alex_oncall, rita_sre, jordan_runtime, ryan_infra].
alex_oncall: wrapping up notes: root cause: unbounded long-context prefill requests increasing per-session KV cache until GPU OOMs -> container restarts -> node flaps. Mitigation: runtime throttles, kv cache cap, node cordon + restart. Long-term: API rate limits + model-side guards + compacting/coldmodel fallback.
rita_sre: tagging postmortem owners. adding timeline and logs in the incident doc. will schedule blameless postmortem async.
maya_cust-success: sent customer emails and updated support tickets. will monitor for any follow-ups.
ryan_infra: keeping node-42 offline for deeper diagnostics. will re-introduce after driver firmware check.
alex_oncall: handing off to night team at 1829520000. closing active page. thanks all. :pray:
rita_sre: ack and standing by for postmortem notes.
jordan_runtime: ack. attaching canary logs to INF-4823.
maya_cust-success: ack.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to "observed - mitigated". If any residual errors occur, reopen thread or pagedocs will trigger next steps."
